era: 2019 Uber Eats web (home 2019-05/07 and store 2019-04 captures): white header with the black-and-green 'Uber Eats' wordmark, the landing hero 'Discover restaurants that deliver near you' with a square address field and a green #3e9920 'Find Food' button, the two cards 'Your restaurant – delivered' and 'Deliver the Eats', and a footer with the language list, About Uber Eats, Become a Delivery Partner, Become a Restaurant Partner, See all cities, Pricing, Help, FAQs, Blog, Privacy and Terms. The same landing page for every signed-out visitor.
